definitions.explanation: An unspecified small number of occasions, typically two to five or so. The prefix {数|すう} (several) attaches to the counter {回|かい} (times, occurrences).

examples.english: We meet several times a year.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧{数回|すうかい}⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: Take this medicine several times a day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{数回|すうかい}⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}した→出張する：26986_shucchousuru⟧。
examples.english: Last year I went on several business trips abroad.

notes:
The prefix ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ attaches to counters to mean "several" of that unit. Vaguer than a specific number, but implies a modest count rather than many.
